value: Combined Shaoyang and Yangming interior excess pattern.
Study clues include alternating chills and fever, chest or hypochondriac fullness, persistent nausea or vomiting, epigastric or abdominal fullness and pain, and constipation.
Additional source clues include a yellow tongue coating and a powerful wiry, rapid pulse.
